meta.title: Costa Rica road trip
meta.tz: Costa Rica UTC−6 · Oslo is 7 h ahead
meta.basics: Route: draft D2 (approved 13 Oct). 14 nights · about 1,180 km, about 32 h driving over 6 days · fuel: to check

day1.title: Arrive · taxi
day1.plan: Land 17:30. Taxi to the Hampton (at the airport). No car today. Early night.

day2.title: Car → La Fortuna
day2.plan: 12:00 pick up the car (Vamos desk, SJO airport; Vamos may deliver earlier, ask). Drive to La Fortuna, arrive about 16:00.

day3.title: Volcano + waterfall + hot springs
day3.plan: Full-day tour (10 h, pickup from the hotel): La Fortuna waterfall, Maleku lunch, Arenal volcano walk, hot springs. No driving.

day4.title: Río Celeste (maybe)
day4.plan: Idea: Río Celeste waterfall, Tenorio park (1 h 45 each way, 250 steps down). Or a lazy day at the hot springs.

day5.title: Don Juan coffee + chocolate
day5.plan: Don Juan Arenal tour (2 h; 09:00, 10:00, 14:00 or 15:00). Afternoon: hot springs. No driving.

day6.title: To Tamarindo
day6.plan: Leave 08:00. Long drive (5 h 30). Afternoon: beach.

day8.title: To Fiesta Resort
day8.plan: Leave 09:00, arrive about 14:00. All inclusive: pool + food.

day9.title: To Tortuguero (car + boat)
day9.plan: Leave 07:00. Via San José + Ruta 32 to La Pavona (5 h 15). Park the car (secure lot). 15:15 boat (12:45 if early), about 1 h.

day10.title: Tortuguero
day10.plan: Canal boat tour + national park. No car.

day11.title: To Punta Cocles
day11.plan: 06:40 or 08:40 boat back to La Pavona. Drive via Guápiles + Limón (4 h 45).

day12.title: Ride The Rainforest
day12.plan: Horse ride on the beach + jungle (Ride The Rainforest, Punta Cocles). Book ahead.

day13.title: Cahuita
day13.plan: Cahuita National Park (open every day 8–16; about 20 min drive). Beach.

day14.title: Back to SJO
day14.plan: Long day: leave 07:00 (6 h 30). Ruta 32 over Braulio Carrillo. Fog + landslides possible.

day15.plan: Slow morning, pack. Fill up. Car back at SJO by 14:00 (saves a day) or 17:00 (change asked). Fly 19:30.

car.name: Rental car: Full Size SUV 4x4
car.pickup: San José International Airport (SJO), Thu 29 Oct 2026, 12:00
car.warn: ⚠️ Return change asked: Wed 11 Nov 17:00 at SJO. Email sent, waiting for Vamos.
car.car: Full Size SUV 4x4, 2500cc, automatic, petrol. Check 4 big bags fit.
car.insurance: SLI/TPL is required; a credit card can't replace it. Ask for an all-in price with SLI. CDW can sometimes be skipped with a card letter.
car.watch: Returning after 18:30 can cost an extra day. Check grace period. Ask about Quick Pass for tolls. Add Stian as driver?
car.licence: Norwegian licence OK, no international permit. Carry passport.

info52.name: Fuel prices
info52.text: From 3 Oct 2026: Súper 764 CRC/L, Plus 91 719 CRC/L, Diesel 785 CRC/L, same at every station. One tank covers any single drive.

info53.name: Tolls
info53.text: Small, on Ruta 27 (e.g. Pozón 570 CRC, Atenas 750 CRC): card, cash or Quick Pass.

t_volc.name: Arenal volcano + La Fortuna waterfall + hot springs (GetYourGuide)
t_volc.notes: Pickup in La Fortuna. Lunch, park fees, hot springs + 1 cocktail included. https://www.getyourguide.com/la-fortuna-l1904/arenal-volcano-la-fortuna-waterfall-and-hot-springs-tour-t192264/

t_dja.name: Don Juan Arenal coffee + chocolate (La Fortuna)
t_dja.notes: The La Fortuna farm (not Monteverde). Free pickup from most town hotels. https://donjuantoursarenal.com/

t_rc.name: Río Celeste waterfall (Tenorio park)
t_rc.price: Tour from 165 USD; park ticket about 32 USD
t_rc.notes: 250 steps down. 1 h 45 each way from La Fortuna. https://www.getyourguide.com/bijagua-de-upala-l215361/rio-celeste-fossen-luksustur-sertifisert-guide-lunsj-t1381037/

t_tortboat.name: Tortuguero: La Pavona parking + boats
t_tortboat.when: Thu 5 Nov (15:15 boat) · back Sat 7 Nov (06:40/08:40)
t_tortboat.price: Boat about 8–10 USD pp each way; parking about 20–23 USD/night
t_tortboat.notes: Book boat + parking bundle (pavonaparking.com or smithtortugueroboats.com). Times change with the river: confirm.

t_ride.name: Ride The Rainforest (horse riding), Punta Cocles
t_ride.notes: Guided horse rides, beach + jungle. +506 6192 8939 · ridetherainforest.com

info59.name: Coffee: skip
info59.text: Skip: Café Britt (a show, not a working farm) and Hacienda Espíritu Santo (closed since 30 May 2025). Ask farms whether the mill runs in late Oct / early Nov.

good61.name: Entry
good61.text: No visa for Norwegians, up to 180 days. May be asked for a return ticket (we have one) and about 100 USD per person per month.

good62.name: Driving
good62.text: Drive on the right. Limits: 40 km/h towns, 60–80 rural, 100 max. Speed cameras, big fines. No driving after dark (dark about 17:30); arrive by 16:30–17:00. Never drive into water you can't see the bottom of. One-lane bridge: the side with the CEDA sign waits. Right on red only if clear and no sign. Seatbelts on.

good_c13.name: Tortuguero
good_c13.text: No road. Park at La Pavona (secure, staffed lot), boat about 1 h. Take only a small bag. No valuables in the car.

good64.name: Weather
good64.text: End of rainy season. October is the wettest; drier in November. Sunny mornings, rainy afternoons. Caribbean side is dry Sep–Oct, wet in Nov (backup if the Pacific is bad).

good65.name: Money
good65.text: Colones (CRC). US dollars OK in tourist areas. Cards work almost everywhere.

good66.name: Day 1
good66.text: Land in the dark. Taxi to the Hampton at the airport. Car on 29 Oct.

good67.name: Waze
